messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated GPU OOM rate on decode-stream pool (us-west-2). Affected service: /v1/streams/decode. Error class: CUDA_OOM. Spike started ~1736004300. Pager route: #incidents -> oncall.
maria (oncall): ack. I’m on it. tagging thomas and jay. any immediate customer reports?
kevin (support): getting a ticket from AcmeCorp showing repeated 502s and request drops during long streaming sessions. Not all requests fail, but noisy.
jay (eng): looking at tail logs — we’re seeing runaway token generation where client-sent max_tokens header is ignored for some streaming paths. suspect header bypass in new routing shim.
sai (sre): CPU looks fine; GPU mem usage on decode nodes climbed to 98% and then OOMs. Affected node set: decode-streamer-*-usw2. Eviction loops causing container restarts.
maria (oncall): immediate mitigation: 1) throttle streaming generation to 2 rps per token for suspicious clients, 2) disable the experimental header passthrough on the streaming route, 3) temp scale-up fallback to smaller model variant. Can someone run the quick throttle policy?
thomas (infra): applying policy now — adding a quota rule for route /v1/streams/decode to cap tokens-per-request to 2000 and per-connection concurrency to 1. patch:

```
# temporary ingress policy
route: /v1/streams/decode
max_tokens_enforced: 2000
concurrency_limit: 1
enforce: true
```

thomas (infra): policy pushed (policy-id: pol-4792). ops-bot reports success on 4/6 frontends, rolling.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: policy pol-4792 applied to frontends: ff-12, ff-13, ff-14, ff-15. Remaining: ff-16, ff-17 (rolling deploy ongoing).
jay (eng): I’ve reproduced the header bypass locally — the routing shim code path for streaming didn't pass max_tokens into the decode call when X-Max-Tokens is present AND chunked stream mode. Fix is small; preparing patch.
jay (eng): patch diff:
```
- if (stream_mode) call_decode(payload)
+ if (stream_mode) call_decode(payload, {max_tokens: headers['x-max-tokens'] || default})
```
jay (eng): opening PR -> #3892. requesting hotfix backport to the 1.12 streaming runtime.
maria (oncall): good. while we hotfix, keep the token cap in place. kevin — draft a short customer notice: "Transient request failures for long streaming sessions while we throttle and patch. We’ll update in 30m." Keep it opaque re infra.
kevin (support): drafting now. sending to maria for sign-off.
deploy-bot: :package: Deploy started for release/1.12-hotfix (PR #3892) to staging. CI: all green.
jay (eng): staging looks good. running small e2e with streaming tokens=5000 -> now honors header and caps at 5000; before we saw unbounded.
thomas (infra): rolling hotfix to canary pool (canary-decode-01). Monitoring GPU mem.
sai (sre): canary initial metrics: mem usage stable, no OOMs in last 6 mins. If that stays, roll to remaining decode streamers.
maria (oncall): handoff to thomas for roll and post-deploy verification. I’ll update incident channel and customer note.
maria (oncall): status update -> mitigation applied (token cap + throttle), hotfix PR merged to release/1.12 and rolling to decode pool. Customer impact: partial request drops for long streaming sessions; affected customers: AcmeCorp (high), BetaApps (medium). Estimated remediation ETA: 25–40m.
thomas (infra): rolling complete to all decode streamers. ops-bot: all nodes reporting healthy. restarting a few containers to clear OOM state.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: rollout complete on decode-stream pool. nodes: 12/12 healthy. OOM events reduced to baseline.
kevin (support): customer update sent to AcmeCorp: we applied throttling and a patch to streaming runtime; monitoring closely. they replied: "thanks, let us know when we can resume long sessions" — suggested to provide guidance about max_tokens in SDK.
jay (eng): follow-up: we'll add a regression test to catch header passthrough in streaming mode and add telemetry to alert when token requests > configured max by a factor of 2. filing ticket ENG-5921.
sai (sre): telemetry note for postmortem: capture sequence of events + kernel OOM logs for top 3 node IDs and attach flame graphs. Also list all clients that triggered >2k tokens in last 24h.
maria (oncall): good. I’m closing the pager but leaving the incident open for postmortem. handoff: thomas (infra) will own remediation and postmortem artifacts; jay will own code fix and tests; kevin will coordinate customer comms. If anything re-regresses, page me immediately.
thomas (infra): acknowledged. creating incident doc and filling escalation notes: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1736004321 (stub).
jay (eng): quick note — root cause summary for postmortem: streaming routing shim omitted max_tokens in a specific chunked-mode code path, allowing clients to bypass server-enforced token caps, causing runaway generation that exhausted GPU memory and triggered OOM restarts.
maria (oncall): timeline pinned. thanks team. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident status changed: Mitigated -> Stable. Incident lead: thomas (infra). Postmortem owner: jay (eng).
